g.text: The input is split into chunks, one per machine.
Each machine runs map() on its own chunk. No talking to the others.
Each map() emits a (key, 1) pair for every record in its chunk.
Shuffle: every pair travels to the ONE reducer that owns its key.
All 3 (A, 1) pairs, from every mapper, land together at reduce(A).
All 2 (B, 1) pairs, from every mapper, land together at reduce(B).
Reduce: each reducer sums its own group, locally. A = 3, B = 2.
You write map() and reduce(). Only the shuffle crosses the network.
